definitions.explanation: An internationally recognized distress signal, used to request help in emergencies.
A figurative request for help or assistance in a difficult situation.

examples.japanese: SOS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: The ship sent out an SOS.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遭難|そうなん}{者|しゃ}→遭難者：27894_sounansha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧SOS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The person in distress sent an SOS signal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧SOS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I send out an SOS asking for help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人手|ひとで}{不足|ぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧SOS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧だ。
examples.english: We're in SOS mode due to staff shortage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧SOS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I sent an SOS to my colleague before the deadline.

notes:
SOS is the international Morse code distress signal (· · · — — — · · ·).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- SOS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send an SOS
- SOS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transmit an SOS
- SOS⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧: SOS signal
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧SOS: emergency SOS

USAGE:
- Often used to describe desperate situations
- SOS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: in crisis mode
- SOS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to ask for urgent help
